description: Owner-approved (2026-11-09) PROVISIONAL exchange-derived factors for six demergers. Not verified: promote only after the original circular confirms (1) the special pre-open session applied to this security and date, (2) the official adjusted base price equals the bhavcopy observation, (3) the entitlement ratio and terms match the recorded action, (4) the factor uses the correct previous cum-entitlement close.
formula: factor = base_price / prev_close, base_price = ex-date OPEN (special pre-open session settlement) in the NSE bhavcopy, prev_close = previous session's close
